values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A TC Energy fact sheet says the East Lateral Xpress project adds 725,000 Dth/d of capacity to a new delivery point in Plaquemines Parish. The gas goes to Venture Global's Gator Express Pipeline for delivery to the Plaquemines LNG terminal.

verifications.note: Fact sheet names the project and the Plaquemines LNG terminal as the destination.

records.researcher_notes: The sheet already says yes. The TC Energy fact sheet confirms it and names the terminal. The EIA October 2026 project notes say the same.

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A FERC order from 2020 approves the Louisiana XPress expansion for a 20-year, 800,000 Dth/d contract with Sabine Pass Liquefaction. The gas goes by Kinder Morgan Louisiana to the Sabine Pass LNG terminal for Train 6 feedgas.

verifications.note: FERC order says the expansion serves Sabine Pass Liquefaction, delivered to the Sabine Pass LNG terminal in Cameron Parish.

records.researcher_notes: New tag. The FERC order names Sabine Pass Liquefaction as the shipper holding about 95 percent of the new capacity.

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A 2019 Federal Register notice of Commonwealth LNG's FERC application describes 3.04 miles of 30-inch pipeline that connects the LNG facility with existing interstate and intrastate pipeline systems in Cameron Parish.

verifications.note: Notice describes the 3.04 mile 30-inch pipeline tied to the Commonwealth LNG facility.
